decision.summary: A multi-axis offset begins abruptly near index 580–585 (N/E up, U down), persists through 595, and shows no confirmed opposing return within allowed context [545,630]; U exhibits only partial recovery, and N/E do not revert. The event satisfies onset and sustained interior criteria but lacks a definitive return on any axis, warranting uncertain status.

intervals.observation: N and E show sustained upward shift from ~580–585, persisting through 595; U shows sharp drop (~5 MAD) at 585–590 with no clear opposing return within allowed context [545,630]. Return in U is partial and unresolved by index 630; N/E remain elevated without reversal. Onset is abrupt (2–3 samples), interior is stable, but return is unobserved/ambiguous.
